children: On September 11, 2026, Nasdaq notified the company of a staff determination to delist its common stock for failing to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price under Listing Rule 5550(a)(2). The company plans to appeal and request a hearing, which will stay any suspension and the Form 25-NSE filing; the stock will remain listed on Nasdaq pending the outcome.
